typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ConfigID as integer,
		ProcessName as string,
		RunResult as string,
		RunDate as timestamp,
		messages as string,
		WorkflowRunId as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT cf.ConfigID,        cf.ProcessName,        rh.RunResult,        rh.RunDate, 	   rh.WorkflowRunId, rh.[messages] FROM   (SELECT MAX(RunHistoryId)  RunHistoryId,                 CAST(RunDate AS DATE) AS RunDate,                 ConfigID          FROM   dbo.RUNHISTORY         GROUP  BY CAST(RunDate AS DATE),                    ConfigID) AS rrh        INNER JOIN dbo.RUNHISTORY rh                 ON rrh.RunHistoryId = rh.RunHistoryId                   AND CAST(rrh.RunDate AS DATE) = CAST(rh.RunDate AS DATE)                    AND rrh.ConfigID = rh.ConfigID    	   INNER JOIN dbo.EDICONFIG cf  	          ON cf.ConfigId = rh.ConfigId 		AND CAST(rh.RunDate AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server	source(output(
		ConfigID as long,
		ProcessName as string,
		RunResult as string,
		RunDate as timestamp,
		messages as string,
		MarketName as string,
		WorkflowRunID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from dbo.EDItorJobRunHistory',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPJobHistoryLKPTABLE
SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server,LKPJobHistoryLKPTABLE lookup(SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@ProcessName == LKPJobHistoryLKPTABLE@ProcessName && SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@RunResult == LKPJobHistoryLKPTABLE@RunResult && SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@RunDate == LKPJobHistoryLKPTABLE@RunDate && SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@WorkflowRunId == LKPJobHistoryLKPTABLE@WorkflowRunID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPJobHistory
LKPJobHistory select(mapColumn(
		ConfigID = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@ConfigID,
		ProcessName = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@ProcessName,
		RunResult = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@RunResult,
		RunDate = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@RunDate,
		messages = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@messages,
		WorkflowRunId = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@WorkflowRunId,
		MarketName = MarketName,
		WorkflowRunID = SRCGetJobHistoryfromERDB1Server@WorkflowRunId
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPJobHistorySelect
LKPJobHistorySelect filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLKPJobHistory
FilterLKPJobHistory sink(input(
		ProcessName as string,
		messages as string,
		ConfigID as long,
		RunDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RunResult as string,
		WorkflowRunID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ProcessName,
		messages,
		ConfigID,
		RunDate,
		RunResult,
		WorkflowRunID = WorkflowRunId)) ~> DSTStageJobHistoryonPDSServer
